sources.title: MFAD Consular Services: travel-visa categories for Kosovo citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora, Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The live MFAD diplomatic-missions domain presents a four-column outbound country table, but its own public WordPress metadata is dated March 2022. The table therefore cannot be treated as a current controlled destination schedule.
sources.supportingExcerpt: VIZAT PËR SHTETASIT KOSOVAR PËR UDHËTIM JASHTË REPUBLIKËS SË KOSOVËS

sources.title: MFAD Consular Services page metadata
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora, Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFAD site’s unauthenticated WordPress API returns the publication and modification timestamps for the same Consular Services page.

sources.title: Ministry of Internal Affairs: full EES implementation notice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs, Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The current 10 April 2026 Interior Ministry notice defines the biometric-passport condition for short Schengen travel only. It supplies no rule for any of the 56 non-Schengen or unresolved destinations.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Qytetarët e Republikës së Kosovës mund të udhëtojnë pa vizë në Zonën Schengen për qëndrime afatshkurtra.
